tree.heading: Account; correspondent account; payable-through account
tree.text: The terms “account”, “correspondent account”, and “payable-through account” have the meanings given those terms in section 5318A of title 31.

tree.heading: Defense article; defense service; training
tree.text: The terms “defense article”, “defense service”, and “training” have the meanings given those terms in section 2794 of this title.

tree.heading: Financial institution
tree.text: The term “financial institution” means a financial institution specified in subparagraph (A), (B), (C), (D), (E), (F), (G), (H), (I), (J), (M), or (Z) of section 5312(a)(2) of title 31.

tree.heading: Foreign financial institution
tree.text: The term “foreign financial institution” has the meaning given that term in section 561.308 of title 31, Code of Federal Regulations (or any corresponding similar regulation or ruling).

tree.heading: Foreign person
tree.text: The term “foreign person” means any individual or entity that is not a United States citizen, a permanent resident alien, or an entity organized under the laws of the United States or any jurisdiction within the United States.

tree.heading: Knowingly
tree.text: The term “knowingly”, with respect to conduct, a circumstance, or a result, means that a person has actual knowledge, or should have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result.

tree.heading: Special Russian crude oil project
tree.text: The term “special Russian crude oil project” means a project intended to extract crude oil from—

children.text: the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation in waters more than 500 feet deep;
shale formations located in the Russian Federation.
